item.title: Version 0.1.10 (29)
item.description:
Cue durations on the timeline, a license agreement, and a gentler unstar.

  • Cue durations: each cue in the Cues lane now shows a gold line running to where the cue finishes, using the times downloaded from Eos. A button in the Cues track header shows or hides them.
  • License agreement: Program Feed is freeware. The license is under Program Feed ▸ License Agreement… and summarized in the About panel; you'll be asked to agree to it once on first launch.
  • Starred at Top: a recording or group you unstar stays put for 2 seconds before it moves, so a slip can be starred again right away.

item.title: Version 0.1.10 (28)
item.description:
Program Feed now keeps itself up to date.

  • Program Feed checks for a new version once a day and offers to install it.
  • Program Feed ▸ Check for Updates… checks now.
